meta.description: Lifts and lowers the margin of a cap in lobes around it, like the wavy margin of a chanterelle. Every ray bends in its own plane, so it keeps its length. The waves follow how far along its ray a place is, so the node can sit anywhere in the chain of a cap.

cap.description: The paths of the cap node: the rays of the caps and their stipes

waves.description: Lobes around the margin. Real chanterelles have about 4 to 8, thinner flesh gives more. Read for every cap, so a random node gives every cap its own count. Here path_info length reads how long the rays of the cap are, so a round node can give a larger cap more lobes.

amplitude.description: How far the margin moves up and down, as a share of the length of a ray from the stipe to the margin: about 1 / waves for a wavy margin. A value alone waves the outer part of the cap. Connect a curve to set it from the centre (alpha 0) to the margin (alpha 1), the waves follow how it rises. Read for every lobe, so a random node gives every lobe its own height.

uneven_spacing.description: How much the lobes vary in width, 0 = evenly spaced around the cap. Every cap gets its own spacing from its stipe.
